text:
Sasha: FYI security scan flagged tokenizers CVE-2026-1423 in 0.13.2 — wheels include an unsafe C extension. CI started failing on macOS and manylinux runners. Proposing a temporary pin to 0.13.1 in our constraints file and opening a hotfix branch. Any objections?

Maria: Saw the macOS failure on runner-macos-2 yesterday — logs show 'undefined symbol: PyUnicode_AsUCS4' during wheel import. I reproduced locally with manylinux2014. Agree with pin while upstream publishes a patch.

Raj: Quick Q — does this affect private deployments that integrate with our KMS for key wrapping? I don't think runtime is impacted but want to confirm no supply-chain vector here.

Kevin: My read is it's a wheel build/runtime binary issue, not KMS. If upstream ships a fix within 24h we can avoid pinning. Otherwise suggest we add a CI workaround: force source build in CI for tokenizers by using `--no-binary tokenizers` or add a constraints pin, whichever is quickest. That will slow test runs. :eyes:

Andre: For minimal churn, do a targeted edit to poetry.lock or export a tiny constraints file at `ci/constraints/tokenizers.txt` and point the deps job at it. That unblocks builds without regenerating the whole lockfile. We can revert after upstream fixes.

security-bot: Created SEC-2026-1423, assigned Sasha, Kevin. Priority: P1. Tracking label: tokenizers-ci-failure.

Sasha: I'll open the hotfix branch + PR to add the constraints file and a note in the release checklist. Kevin can you take the backport and CI changes? @Kevin :shipit:

Kevin: On it. Plan: `poetry lock --no-update && poetry export -f constraints.txt --without-hashes > ci/constraints/tokenizers.txt`, commit the constraints, update CI pipeline to include that file, then run macOS-only matrix to validate. I'll also open a follow-up issue to remove the pin once upstream releases.

Maria: After PR is merged can we run a single macOS matrix run, please? I'll queue it and monitor.

Andre: FYI I spun up a temporary macOS runner with extra disk to avoid wheel build OOMs during the forced source builds. Let me know if you need it attached to a specific pipeline.

Sasha: Thanks team — proceeding with PR. Will add a short remediation playbook to SEC-2026-1423 describing: reproduce steps, temporary constraints, CI workarounds, and backport plan.

Kevin: PR created: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/inference/pulls/4821 (hotfix/ci-tokenizers-pin). Will run the macOS matrix after CI reconfiguration.

Maria: Verified macOS job passed on the temporary runner with the constraints file. Marking SEC ticket as "mitigated" pending upstream fix. :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Closing loop — once upstream publishes 0.13.3 with the patch, we'll remove the constraints file and regenerate lockfiles.
